PHASE-2A DESIGN ACTS (grounded in the live crosslink surface, verified 2026-07-28):
1. Finding discrimination (bootstrap rule): a finding is an issue whose PARENT is a review-round issue (parent carries label 'review'). Verified: #750 parent_id=745, #745='Phase 3 execution... adversarial refinement round 1' label ['review']. This is the bootstrap format-carry; Slice 5's filing convention formalizes it.
2. SCOPE REFINEMENT: Slice 1's tracker-join reads only the ENFORCEMENT-SPINE fields the unrouted-findings query needs -- discrimination, routing_present (a 'plan'-kind comment; verified kind exists), closed_before_ratification (closed_at vs the ratification boundary), status/disposition. owner/validator/evidence_reference_present are NOT crosslink-native (verified: finding #750 has no such fields, only a 'result' comment) -- they depend on Slice 5's filing convention, so reading them at Slice 1 would back-depend on a later slice (DAG violation). They stay bootstrap-empty until Slice 5. Recorded as a Slice-1 scope decision.
3. Test seam: pure mappers (routing_present, is_finding-via-parent-review-label, closed_before_ratification-vs-boundary) unit-tested with canned crosslink JSON; a few real-crosslink integration tests over a temp repo. Red gate = failing-executed on the positive/after assertions against minimal mapper bodies.

VERIFIED THIS SESSION: (1) discrimination rule is crisp — a finding = an issue whose PARENT is 'review'-labeled (finding #750 parent=745[review] subissues=0; rounds have parent=None+subissues; work issues no parent). is_finding(parent_labels) is the correct design. REVERTED from the working tree (git checkout acquire.rs) to avoid an orphaned dead-code red gate; re-lands WITH the effectful read in the focused 2b, trivially reproducible from this record.
THE 2B DESIGN DECISION (the real blocker, surfaced by grounding — the AIE cost finding, live): reading findings-with-routing needs a 'crosslink issue show' PER finding ('issue list --json' omits comments/labels) = O(n) subprocess calls. acquire_snapshot runs on the statusline (250ms budget), so O(n) findings there is a budget hazard. Two forks to resolve before coding: (a) TWO-PATH acquisition — lightweight statusline acquire (findings feed integrity/health-detail via a PULL, not the hot segment) vs a fuller acquire for the guardrail/CI path; (b) within the full path: bulk query vs bounded per-finding shows vs cache. CHEAPEST FIX + raise candidate: an UPSTREAM crosslink bulk findings+comments export (issue export --json interface returned nothing parseable; confirm or raise). Flag to Platform Engineer — benefits every crosslink adopter.
QUEUED behind the effectful-read design: the assembler (assemble_findings), acquire wiring, guardrail verdict wrapper (wraps snapshot_integrity's unrouted-findings), the commit-msg hook + CI leg, and the vsdd-core->vsdd merge (#15).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
2B DESIGN DECISIONS (operator-approved 2026-07-28):
1. TWO-PATH ACQUISITION adopted. The statusline acquire stays lightweight (milestones + session; findings NOT read on the hot 250ms path — they don't render on the segment; they feed integrity/health-detail via PULL and the guardrail/CI). A fuller findings-read serves the guardrail/CI/report path, where a bounded per-finding 'crosslink issue show' is affordable. This resolves the O(n)-on-statusline blocker; Slice 1's 2b ships on this basis.
2. UPSTREAM RAISE FILED: dollspace-gay/crosslink#52 — bulk issue query lacks comment metadata (no single call returns issues WITH comments; issue list + export are comment-shallow, only issue show is deep = O(n) fan-out). Ask: enrich issue list --json with labels + comment kinds (optionally behind --detail), or add parent_id/closed_at/comments to export --json. Framed as an OPTIMIZATION, not a blocker (two-path lets us ship with bounded per-finding show meanwhile). When it lands, the fuller read collapses to one bulk call.

NEXT (focused 2b): re-land the mapper red gate + assemble_findings; implement the fuller findings-read on the guardrail/CI/report path (bounded per-finding show now; bulk call once crosslink#52 ships); guardrail verdict wrapper; commit-msg hook + CI leg; then the vsdd-core->vsdd merge (#15).
